promptBrief: 设置窗 L1 氛围背景：深夜直播间场景，无人物无文字，中央暗沉均匀供 UI 叠加
generationPrompt:
atmospheric scene background for Kotone, a desktop voice-input app for gamers — a late-night streaming room (深夜直播间) at 2 AM,
featuring NO character, NO people — pure environment atmosphere only,
the scene: a dim gaming desk setup in a dark room — multiple monitor glows at the edges of the frame, an RGB mechanical keyboard with cyan and magenta backlight close-up in one lower corner, a cup of instant noodles with gentle steam on the desk corner, silhouettes of sticky notes and posters on the wall, faint LED strip ambience,
rendered in cel-shaded anime background style using deep blue-black #1A1A2E as the dominant base with neon cyan #00E5FF and magenta #FF2D78 glow accents and subtle #7B2FFF purple ambient light,
COMPOSITION (critical): overall extremely dark and low-key; brightness is concentrated at the frame edges and lower third — the large CENTRAL area of the canvas stays dark, even and uncluttered, a smooth deep #1A1A2E field suitable for overlaying UI text and controls on top,
generous negative space in the center — no bright focal element in the middle, no high-contrast subject,
subtle sound-wave line motifs and faint chat-bubble outlines woven into the ambient light and wall details as decorative elements,
atmospheric lighting and mood: warm, quiet, focused late-night energy,
the background is a believable environment (not a flat color), but kept soft and non-distracting,
landscape 3:2 aspect ratio suitable as an app window background,
no text, no letters, no watermark, no UI controls, no people rendered in the image,
masterpiece, best quality
notes: 模板 promptTemplate 默认含 character 与 1/3-1/2 人物构图，与用户明确要求的'无人物纯氛围背景'冲突，按用户指令优先（character_visual slot 替换为 no-character 场景说明）。中央区域暗且均匀，亮度集中于边缘与中下部；声波/气泡轮廓融入环境光；无 glitch。
